claims.claim: The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition.

claims.claim: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple® today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended September 26, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year.
claims.quote: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple® today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended September 26, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent year over year.

claims.claim: “Today, Apple is proud to report a September quarter revenue record of $114.5 billion, up 12 percent from a year ago, with iPhone reaching a September quarter record and Services reaching an all‑time high, capping off our best fiscal year ever,” said John Ternus, Apple’s CEO.
